correctness.rationale: Exact two-mode diagonalization; weighted orthogonality gives the Hilbert formula; coordinate-sign analysis gives the TV positive-part formula. Strict initial ordering and ordered slopes prove single positive roots. The thermal boundary follows by differentiating the middle Gibbs mass. No numerical-only statement is extrapolated to infinity.

originality.rationale: The acceptance claim is the bidirectional ordering of crossing times for two genuine distances within a single specified reversible canonical three-level gate, with exact rational witnesses. Known three-level Mpemba possibility, generic geometric criteria, and the Hilbert zero-count are explicitly prior work; accessible direct prior full-text and published index did not entail or state the new two-way metric comparison. Residual priority uncertainty is recorded.

value.rationale: Distance choice is a genuine ambiguity in finite-time thermal relaxation experiments and algorithms. Establishing that two proper contractive metrics can report opposite chronologies within the same three-level model, together with exact rational temperatures and unique-crossing formulas, is a structural and experimentally motivated boundary to metric-agnostic Mpemba timing claims; not a routine numerical restatement of existence.
